propositions: CLI reference syntax and options must derive deterministically from registry enumeration and committed package-help bytes, validated by --check flags on both generators
Manual regex parsing, INTERCEPT_COMMANDS census, and hand-maintained command tables must be eliminated; parser artifacts and registries become the sole enumerable input
Help/exit-code/argparse tests must enumerate route classes from registry rather than rebuilding policy sets manually
A clean no-extras wheel must render every approved help form with byte-identical committed bytes and no heavy import side effects
Full-extra contract must resolve all handler/parser/selector references and validate capability-to-extra mappings without executing command logic
Editorial examples and rationale must be structurally separated, registry-linted for spelling, and never override generated syntax
